one_line: A country-level correlation study (Pearson analysis) of ISO 50001 energy-management outcomes, SDG scores, and Network Readiness Index/Industry 4.0 indicators across seven countries; continuous-process sectors (cement, petrochemical, pulp & paper, aluminium, oil & gas) appear only as labels in a table of award-winning organizations, not as sites of applied/validated process work.
